name: Raise Dead

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

summary: Bring back a creature dead for no more than 10 days, if its soul is willing.
text: It returns with 1 Hit Point; poisons and nonmagical diseases are cured, but missing body parts aren't restored and Undead can't be raised. It takes a -4 penalty to D20 Tests that shrinks by 1 with each Long Rest.
